title: Method for producing nitrile rubbers in organic solvents
abstract: The invention relates to a novel method for producing nitrile rubbers by means of radical polymerisation in an organic solvent and in the presence of specific molecular weight regulators. Said polymerisation can be followed by a hydrogenation in order to form hydogenated nitrile rubbers, the hydrogenation advantageously taking place in the same organic solvent. The optionally hydrogenated nitrile rubbers obtained can be produced with a wide variety of molecular weights and polydispersity indices.
